description: The stack read outermost first: a layer sees, and can skip or repeat, everything inside it.
A layer that may call its inner function more than once, such as retry or token refresh; it multiplies the requests and the time of every layer inside it.
Every timeout, wait and refresh on the longest path through the stack; it decides how many attempts fit the callers' deadline.
What the decorator factory received and the wrapper keeps: each built client has its own store, metrics sink and token source.
Time passed in as a callable, so tests advance it themselves instead of sleeping or patching the time module.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
